$comment: Declarative registry of VOLATILE STATE DOMAINS. Authority: docs/protocols/STATE_FRESHNESS_MANDATE.md. This file is tracked on purpose: data/protocols/*.json is gitignored, and a missing registry there would make every consumer silently no-op (see the 0/72 cron incident).

domains.title: Public repo main tip
domains.trap: gh api repos/<r>/commits/<sha> returns 200 for ANY reachable object, including a dangling commit that is on no branch. It proves the object exists, NOT that it is the branch tip. Only a ref lookup (git/ref/heads/main) proves tip. Before reporting a rewrite, also confirm the suspect sha appears in NO branch: gh api 'repos/<r>/branches?per_page=100'.

domains.title: Public repo main ancestry depth
claims: history was truncated to N commits
domains.trap: per_page caps the result; 'length' is a floor, not the true count. A value equal to per_page means 'at least N', never 'exactly N'.

domains.title: Public repo open PR numbers
domains.probe: gh pr list --repo whodaniel/The-New-Fuse --state open --limit 100 --json number --jq '[.[].number]|sort|tostring'
domains.trap: Bots re-file closed PRs under new numbers. A closed PR number does NOT mean the work was abandoned — search for an equivalent re-file before reporting loss.

domains.title: Public repo main protection rules
domains.trap: A 'non_fast_forward' rule means force-push is REJECTED. Do not conclude a force-push succeeded without checking this rule and confirming the ref actually moved.

domains.title: Control-plane files absent from public repo
domains.probe: for f in packages/relay-core/src/master-clock.ts packages/relay-core/src/broker-agent.ts packages/agent-coordination; do gh api "repos/whodaniel/The-New-Fuse/contents/$f?ref=main" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "LEAKED:$f"; done; echo OK
domains.trap: Assert a leak only from a 200 on the public repo at ref=main. Presence in the monorepo or in a sync work-tree is not publication.

domains.title: Local monorepo HEAD + dirty state
domains.probe: git -C . rev-parse --short HEAD && git -C . status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' '
domains.trap: Uncommitted working-tree edits are invisible to anything reading the remote. 'I made the edit' is not 'the edit is committed' is not 'the edit is pushed'.

domains.title: Redis + relay reachability
domains.probe: ( timeout 5 redis-cli ping 2>/dev/null || echo REDIS_UNREACHABLE ) && ( curl -sf -m 5 http://127.0.0.1:3000/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo RELAY_OK || echo RELAY_DOWN )
domains.trap: A LISTENing port is liveness, not reachability. Redis can hold an open port while starved past a 120s ping. Never substitute lsof/pgrep for an actual round-trip.
